test_exceptions.justification: The live PostgreSQL test has a local environment guard; every qualifying CI job supplies OCOR_LIVE_POSTGRES_DSN and rejects skips.
The TypeScript SDK compile-check has a local-tooling guard (tsc on PATH); every qualifying CI job installs Node 20.20.2 and TypeScript 7.0.2 before this test runs and never hits the skip.

The TypeScript SDK conformance suite has a local-tooling guard (node on PATH, SDK built); every qualifying CI job installs Node 20.20.2 and runs npm install/tsc build before this test runs and never hits the skip.

The Phase 3 language-migration benchmark end-to-end smoke test has a local-tooling guard (node v20.20.2 on PATH, compiled benchmark oracle present); every qualifying CI job installs Node 20.20.2 and runs npm install/tsc build (which compiles the benchmark oracle alongside the rest of the SDK) before this test runs and never hits the skip.
